name: Easy Mob Farm
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.

description: The easy mob farm is a server friendly way to capture different kind of animals and mobs to gather their loot. This mod provides several catching items and mob farms to make it more entertaining.
